description: The front entry facade of a contemporary transitional residential home photographed straight-on in even daylight. The exterior walls are clad in painted white brick with a clean, fine-jointed texture. The entry surround and pilasters are finished in smooth grey stone or cast stone, providing a formal contrast to the more casual brick field. The main entry features a pair of tall double French doors with multi-pane glass panels set in matte black frames, providing a classic grid pattern. Flanking the entry door surround are two slender columnar evergreen shrubs — Italian cypress or similar — trimmed neatly to matching heights. At the base of each flanking pilaster, low-growing ornamental plantings and purple flowering shrubs fill the entry beds. The driveway or entry court is paved in light grey interlocking pavers in a running bond pattern. The upper facade features two sets of multi-pane double-hung windows in matte black aluminum frames, and the roofline includes a dark grey architectural shingle. A warm circular glow falls on the grey stone pilasters on each side of the entry door from a pair of symmetrically positioned wall-mounted sources, reading as warm amber discs against the daylit facade. The mood is formal, polished, and transitional — bridging traditional and modern sensibilities. Camera is at standing eye-level, shooting a centered symmetrical view of the full entry facade. The lens is a normal to moderate telephoto, keeping the building flat and well-composed. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
